description: Amendments to planning permission dated 17 March 2023 (RN:23/00543/FULL) for reconstruction and extension of the fourth floor, replacement sash window to rear, installation of extract vents, new timber decking to existing terrace and replacement metal railings at fourth floor. Namely, third floor, existing partitions separating residential unit from common parts upgraded with fire resistant plasterboard lining and rockwool between studs, to provide 60min fire resistant construction, existing floorboards relaid following careful removal to facilitate floor strengthening works, intake/exhaust via airbrick at rear façade, revised location of wardrobe into bedroom, penetrations required in brick wall between bedrooms, utility room added where approved wardrobe was located, revised bathroom layout and change to bathroom sliding door, new ensuite to bedroom, 1 ceramic floor tile finish laid on existing floor substrate, existing floorboards relaid to replace any damaged boards following careful removal to facilitate floor strengthening works, fourth foor, mansard walls rebuilt in Steel Framing System (SFS) construction and finished in render, changes to rooflights above fourth floor, riser to accommodate incoming water for sprinklers, new extract duct rises to roof above WC, new partition and door to form lobby, revised bathroom layout including change to door opening design, new wall mounted bike racks to terrace and water tank to terrace retained - proposed rotation to avoid clash with door (Linked 26/00912/LBC)
